answer: Proof of bandwidth: each epoch, verifier nodes ask every identity at the same moment to stream a fresh 50 MB block derived from its own key and the epoch seed, then time the transfer and check its hash. Identities sharing one connection split its upload like pigment spread over more canvas, so all of them slow down, and that ripple of late replies exposes the shared link. Each extra identity therefore needs its own paid uplink. Limit: cheap data-center bandwidth lowers the price, so the required rate must be high enough that free sybils stay a fable.
